## Why

Task 2899 (R09): `velnor-host` gets a second launch mode, `rust-runner`, that starts `velnor-runner run --jit` once per job in the OrbStack machine `velnor` instead of creating the official runner container pair. This head also builds the controller that runs the mode (decision https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/issues/2899#issuecomment-7202315412, D1 to D4 https://github.com/tailrock
